data.title: Training data for a job-screening AI

message.text: We are training an AI to screen job applications using data on employees hired in the last 10 years.
The AI will screen ALL applicants from next month.

explanation: The training data is 90% men, so the AI will tend to copy that pattern and disadvantage women. Ask for a revision: balance the data and test for fairness first.
hints: Who is in the training data?
Compare the number of men and women.
